name: Marathon under 2 hours

note: 1,111 days across five missions.

name: First image of a black hole
Longest single spaceflight
note: 437 days without coming back down.

name: First solo nonstop sail around the world
Swimming around Great Britain
note: 157 days at sea.

name: First free ascent of The Nose
First solo nonstop flight across the Atlantic
First person to beat NES Tetris

name: First swim across the English Channel
First to reach the South Pole
Long jump of 8.90 m
note: Stood as the world record for almost 23 years.

name: First nonstop balloon flight around the world
Geometry Dash Level - Grief Verified
note: 436,879 attempts over 396 streams, about 2.5 years. Died at 97% twice. Luck still uses the total attempt count, it should only count runs past 50% once that number is known.

name: 100 m in 10.49 seconds
note: Some people argue the wind gauge was wrong that day.

name: 400 m in 43.03 seconds
note: Ran it from lane 8, where you cannot see anyone behind you.

name: Long jump of 8.95 m
note: Broke Bob Beamon's record from 1968.

name: 8 gold medals at one Olympics
note: One of the eight was won by 0.01 seconds.

name: First Yurchenko double pike vault in competition
Perfect game in the World Series
Golden Slam in one year
note: All four Grand Slams and Olympic gold in the same year.

name: Holding all four golf majors at once
3 World Cup wins as a player
Leicester City winning the Premier League
note: Bookmakers had them at 5000 to 1 before the season.

name: 400 not out in a Test match
First voyage around the world
note: About 270 people left. 18 made it back on the one surviving ship.

name: First ship through the Northwest Passage
Shackleton getting every man home
note: Their ship was crushed by ice. All 28 men survived.

name: First climb of the Eiger north face
Crossing the Pacific on a wooden raft
First ascent of Nanga Parbat, solo to the summit
First undisputed trip to the North Pole on foot
First solo row across the Atlantic
Surviving a plane breakup and 11 days alone in the jungle
Highest fall survived without a parachute
note: About 10,000 m.

name: Walking out of the Andes after the 1972 crash
note: Ten days across the mountains with no climbing gear to find help.

name: Around the world through both poles
First to climb the Seven Summits
First solo crossing of Antarctica
note: Used kites to help pull his sled.

name: First solo balloon flight around the world
Solo to the North Pole from Canada with no resupply
Getting free from a canyon after 5 days trapped
Highest skydive ever
note: About 41,400 m, higher than Felix Baumgartner.

name: Tham Luang cave rescue
note: Thirteen people brought out through flooded tunnels.

name: Diving to the deepest point of all five oceans
Laws of motion and gravity
note: Published in the Principia.

name: Theory of evolution by natural selection
Nobel Prizes in two different sciences
note: Physics in 1903, chemistry in 1911. Years of radiation exposure from her work damaged her health.

name: Discovering penicillin
note: Mold got into a dish he left out while on vacation.

name: Proof of the four color theorem
note: First major proof that needed a computer.

name: First woman to win the Fields Medal
First detection of gravitational waves
note: The signal moved the detector mirrors less than the width of a proton.

name: First spacewalk
note: His suit swelled up and he had to let air out of it to fit back inside.

name: First crew to orbit the Moon
First spacecraft in interstellar space
note: 35 years after launch.

name: Landing Curiosity on Mars with a sky crane
First landing on a comet
note: It bounced twice before stopping.

name: First landing on the far side of the Moon
Unfolding the James Webb Space Telescope
note: Hundreds of parts that each had to work the first time.

name: First clear of the osu!mania 4K Eta dan
note: About 10 minutes of nonstop play on the Dan Reform course by [GB]Thaumiel. The whole course needs 96% accuracy or higher, with no pausing and no mods. Saragi cleared it with 96.13%. He never posted an attempt count, so Luck is a guess.

name: First victory on Tower of Spiralling Fates
note: The hardest tower in EToH, rated Unreal in Pit of Misery, made by ciel_azulsky. Runs take over 20 minutes. The winning run came during a 4 hour livestream. Later victors include greenbean1421, Gehadimad, skitsuna and SwiftThunder06.

name: Verifying STONE: Reborn
note: The hardest tower ever beaten in the tower obby community, Mid Unreal at about 13.5. Made by IceNsalt and 7Zakki1. Runs take 30 to 45 minutes or more.

name: First finish of the Barkley Marathons
note: Five loops of about 20 miles each through the woods with no marked trail, in under 60 hours.

name: First woman to finish the Barkley Marathons
note: Finished with 99 seconds to spare.

name: Spartathlon in 20 hours 25 minutes
note: 246 km, and the record held for decades.

name: Swimming from Cuba to Florida
note: Done at age 64 on her fifth try. Parts of the swim were never independently verified.

name: Swimming 1 km at the North Pole
note: In water below 0 degrees, in just a swimsuit.

name: Everest twice in one week without bottled oxygen
Cycling around the world in 80 days
Tightrope walk between the Twin Towers
note: No net and no harness, more than 400 m up.

name: Tightrope walk over Niagara Falls
note: The TV network made him wear a tether.

name: Climbing the outside of the Burj Khalifa
note: Used a rope for safety this time. He is known for free soloing buildings.

name: Landing a wingsuit jump without a parachute
note: Landed on a runway of cardboard boxes.

name: Skydive from 7,600 m with no parachute
note: Landed in a net.

name: Holding your breath for 24 minutes 37 seconds
note: Breathed pure oxygen beforehand, which is allowed for this record.

name: Freediving to 214 m on one breath
note: No limits freediving, using a weighted sled to go down.

name: Winning two Candidates matches 6 to 0
note: Swept Taimanov and Larsen, both top players, without a single draw.

name: Youngest undisputed world chess champion
note: Age 22.

name: 48 chess games at once while blindfolded
Multiplying two 13 digit numbers in 28 seconds
The only human win against AlphaGo in a match
note: Game 4 of 5. AlphaGo won the other four.

name: Losing only 7 checkers games in 45 years
Youngest chess grandmaster at the time
note: Age 15, breaking Bobby Fischer's record.

name: First Rubik's cube solve under 6 seconds
note: 5.66 seconds.

name: Rubik's cube in 3.13 seconds
note: A good scramble helps a lot at this level, so luck plays a real part.

name: Reciting 70,000 digits of pi
note: Took about 10 hours, blindfolded the whole time.

name: Reciting 100,000 digits of pi
note: Took about 16 hours. Never ratified by Guinness.

name: Memorizing 54 shuffled decks of cards in a row
note: 2,808 cards after seeing each one once, with only 8 mistakes.

name: 125 classical chess games in a row without losing
note: Ended by Jan-Krzysztof Duda.

name: World champion in classical, rapid and blitz at once
Youngest chess grandmaster ever
note: Age 12 years, 4 months and 25 days.

name: Winning the 1972 World Chess Championship
note: Ended 24 years of Soviet champions.

name: Beating Deep Blue in a match
note: Won 4 to 2. Deep Blue won the rematch a year later.

name: Winning the French Scrabble championship without speaking French
note: Memorized the French word list in about 9 weeks.

name: Amateur winning the World Series of Poker Main Event
note: Qualified through an $86 online satellite.
